comments.title: Comments & Documentation
comments.notes: C++/CLI uses C-style // single-line and /* */ multi-line comments.

numbers.title: Numbers & Numerics
numbers.notes: C++/CLI provides explicitly sized integer and floating-point primitives with binary and hex support.

booleans.title: Booleans & Conditions
booleans.notes: C++/CLI uses bool / boolean types with true and false literals and logical operators (&&, ||, !).

type_casting.title: Type Casting & Conversion
type_casting.notes: C++/CLI supports explicit type casting using cast operators or constructor functions.

strings.title: Strings & Characters
strings.notes: C++/CLI distinguishes between single-character literals and string sequences or pointer slices.

string_formatting.title: String Formatting
string_formatting.notes: C++/CLI supports string interpolation or printf-style formatting specifiers.

pattern_matching.title: Pattern Matching & Switch
pattern_matching.notes: C++/CLI evaluates branching conditions through switch statements, match expressions, or when constructs.

range.title: Ranges & Slicing
range.notes: C++/CLI represents ranges with range operators (.., ..<) or standard indexed iteration boundaries.

iterators.title: Iterators & Sequences
iterators.notes: C++/CLI implements iteration through Iterator interfaces, generators, or range-for loops.

oop_classes.title: Classes & OOP
oop_classes.notes: C++/CLI models object orientation through classes with constructors/encapsulation or structs with associated methods.

lists.title: Dynamic Arrays & Lists
lists.notes: C++/CLI manages growable dynamic collections using vectors, ArrayLists, or dynamically reallocated heap buffers.

tuples.title: Tuples & Records
tuples.notes: C++/CLI represents heterogeneous records through tuples, structured bindings, or lightweight record structs.

sets.title: Sets & Unique Collections
sets.notes: C++/CLI provides unique collection hashing structures with O(1) average lookup and insertion time.

modules_import.title: Modules, Packages & Imports
modules_import.notes: C++/CLI structures namespaces and external libraries via include directives, package declarations, or module imports.
